Historical global-reload service success does not validate new no-unload sequence.
Cold driver registration can normally attach previously unbound NVIDIA devices.
Ambiguous shared GPU clients and shared reset bridges are refused.
Full VRAM correctness, Gen2 and negotiated x16 are not established.

Empty captured Xid section is not proof of full journal coverage.
